metadata.question: Did the snow water equivelent at Donner Pass higher in February than April in 2022?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about snow water equivalent (SWE) at Donner Pass, comparing February vs April 2022. This requires: 1. Data Collection: I'll use NASA's Snow Water Equivalent data from the NLDAS collection 2. Location: Donner Pass coordinates (approximately 39.3°N, 120.3°W) 3. Time periods: February 2022 vs April 2022 4. Processing: Calculate mean SWE for each month and compare I'll use the NASA NLDAS collection which has SWE data. The band is typically 'SWE_0_200cm' for snow water equivalent. I need to: - Define geometry for Donner Pass - Get SWE data for Feb 2022 and Apr 2022 - Calculate mean SWE for each period - Compare values and determine if Feb > Apr - Handle any data availability issues ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const donnerPass = ee.Geometry.Point([-120.32, 39.31]); // Donner Pass coordinates const feb2022 = ee.DateRange('2022-02-01', '2022-02-28'); const apr2022 = ee.DateRange('2022-04-01', '2022-04-30'); // 2. Data Acquisition - NASA NLDAS Snow Water Equivalent const sweCollection = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/NLDAS/FORA0125_H002') .select('SWE_0_200cm'); // Snow water equivalent band const febCollection = sweCollection.filterDate(feb2022); const aprCollection = sweCollection.filterDate(apr2022); // Check collection sizes const febSize = febCollection.size().getInfo(); const aprSize = aprCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`February 2022 Images: ${febSize}`); console.log(`April 2022 Images: ${aprSize}`); if (febSize === 0 || aprSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate mean SWE for each period const febMean = febCollection.mean(); const aprMean = aprCollection.mean(); // Get pixel counts and mean values const febStats = febMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: donnerPass, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const aprStats = aprMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: donnerPass, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const febResult = febStats.getInfo(); const aprResult = aprStats.getInfo(); const febSWE = febResult.SWE_0_200cm_mean; const febCount = febResult.SWE_0_200cm_count; const aprSWE = aprResult.SWE_0_200cm_mean; const aprCount = aprResult.SWE_0_200cm_count; console.log(`February SWE: ${febSWE !== null ? febSWE.toFixed(3) : 'null'}, Pixels: ${febCount}`); console.log(`April SWE: ${aprSWE !== null ? aprSWE.toFixed(3) : 'null'}, Pixels: ${aprCount}`); // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (febCount === 0 || aprCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); } else if (febSWE === null || aprSWE === null || isNaN(febSWE) || isNaN(aprSWE)) { console.log("C3"); } else if (febSWE > aprSWE) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
